conventions.tier_values: standard | standard_peak | undiscounted | undiscounted_peak | standard_2026_08_16 | standard_2026_08_16_peak
conventions.cache_note: Server-side KV cache. Cache hits billed at input_cache_hit price ("cache miss" in the official pricing table = the plain input price).
conventions.v4_pro_discount_note: deepseek-v4-pro's 75%-off promotion ended 2026-05-31T15:59:00Z; the standard and undiscounted tiers are the same post-promotion official price and are kept numerically identical in this file. This distinction is superseded by price_update_2026_08_16_note below once that cutover takes effect.
conventions.price_update_2026_08_16_note: A new peak/off-peak pricing structure takes effect 2026-08-16T16:00:00Z, verified directly against DeepSeek's official pricing table on 2026-08-13 (ahead of the cutover). Off-peak rates are exactly half the peak rates, same peak windows as the existing standard tier. Stored under standard_2026_08_16 / standard_2026_08_16_peak — PriceManager switches to these once 'now' reaches the cutover, for both deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro (the v4-pro promotion/undiscounted distinction becomes moot once this supersedes it). Until the cutover, standard / standard_peak / undiscounted / undiscounted_peak remain the currently-billed prices — do not overwrite them early.
conventions.peak_pricing_note: Effective 2026-07-15, peak-hour surcharge applies: all billing dimensions cost 2x the off-peak rate. Peak hours (UTC): 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 (UTC+8: 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00), Monday through Friday only — all other hours, and all day Saturday/Sunday, are off-peak (off-peak = half the peak rate). Use *_peak tier variants for peak-hour cost estimation. Same windows and weekday restriction apply to the 2026-08-16 pricing update.

peak_pricing.applies_to: all billing dimensions (input, input_cache_hit, output) across all tiers
peak_pricing.peak_days: Monday through Friday only; Saturday and Sunday are entirely off-peak
peak_pricing.off_peak_note: Off-peak rate = half the peak rate. The base (non-_peak) tiers store the off-peak price.
